grade.message: So our flight into Chicago (DLE02A) sat on the ground for over five hours and we only got to the River North Hotel at about 1:30 am. They told the four of us they were overbooked and sent us to a place in Evanston for the night, with a cab. We paid for two nights (conf RNE02B) and stayed the second night there. I was told the first night would be refunded in 3 to 5 days. Nothing came, and my card company says no refund ever arrived. I want that first night back like I was promised. Our December stay at River North is fine, leave it. marcus.webb@example.com, card 6202.
